__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It seems to be made of nothing more than darkness ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A shadow guardian screams a challenge and attacks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shadow guardian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks haggard and sickly; no doubt he's been lost here for quite some time.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An emaciated adventurer is here looking lost and hopeless.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle adventurer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Edgar says 'pardon me, can you tell me where to buy cups?'

You see before you, one of Midgaard's finest fighting elite, the mighty
bunny slayer himself, Edgar the Horrible!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Edgar the Human Swordpupil
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle edgar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks quite strong.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge diamond golem is standing guard here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle diamond golem

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He seems to be contemplating life, love and the mysteries of the universe.
Then again, he may just have a headache.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young mage wanders about, oblivious to all.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mage young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks rather harmless, but then again so does a sleeping dragon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Strick is here levitating drinks to his customers.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle strick bartender

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Tatorious winks at you mischievously.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Tatorious the wizard is here counting his earnings.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle tatorious wizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Ezmerelda the cook is here stirring a large pot of something.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ezmerelda cook

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The cook's assistant is here assisting the cook.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle assistant mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Though his clothes are all in rags, you can see that at one time they must
have been fine garments. A metal muzzle has been fitted over the poor
wretch's mouth, whether to keep him from screaming, or to silence his spell
casting you cannot tell.

He looks quite mad, no doubt he's been mistreated horribly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A prisoner is chained to the wall here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prisoner

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks rather dirty.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Jailor is here enjoying a comfortable nap.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jailor mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The broom screams 'Take that you lout!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A straw broom is here leaning against the wall.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle broom

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The hands twitch with anticipation of strangling someone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pair of disembodied hands floats in the air here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lesser guardian hands

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The eyes smolder with hatred.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pair of disembodied eyes floats here glaring at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guardian greater eyes

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks quite sleepy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A visiting mage is here snoring away in peaceful slumber.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mage visitor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She looks quite intent on her studies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young apprentice magic user is here doing magical studies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apprentice young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks to be oblivious to all but the spell he is memorizing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young apprentice is here mumbling words of magic to himself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apprentice young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He seems to be dreaming.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young apprentice is sleeping here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apprentice young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks like a mischievous youth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young apprentice is here teasing a cornered kitten.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apprentice young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The little ball of fur looks very unhappy.  Singed fur and a few minor burns
mark its mottled coat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small kitten is here meowing in terror.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle kitten

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The student yawns.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A student of spells is here looking quite bored
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle student

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks quite angry at your interruption.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The instructor screams at your interruption and attacks you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle instructor teacher mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He blinks in and out of existence, trying to master the spell.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A student of spells is here trying to master invisibility.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle student

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A spell teacher screams at your interruption and attacks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle teacher mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She looks to have collapsed from sheer boredom.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A student of spells has fallen asleep at her desk here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle student

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An old wizard is here making a speech
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wizard speaker mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young mage is here learning hand to hand combat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mage young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She looks quite rugged. In fact, she more resembles a warrior than a magic
user.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The battle mistress is here teaching the fine uses of a dagger.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mistress battle

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A spell teacher is here relaxing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mage teacher

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An aged wizard is sleeping here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A scribe is here working on some manuscripts.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle scribe mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She's quite cute.  Too bad her only interest seems to be the words of
lore she is translating.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A scribe is here working diligently on some translations.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle scribe mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He seems to be so old, his skin has become nothing but a giant wrinkle.
The master scribe screams 'How dare you interrupt my important work???'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master scribe is here looking a little upset
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master scribe

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The scribe's assistant is here folding parchments.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle assistant scribe

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Enchanter is here placing a dweomer upon well made sword.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master enchanter mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks quite sharp.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A well crafted sword lies on the work table here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sword dancing

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks like he's been quaffing too many potions. His eyes dart around
wildly, and he starts to drool.

The Mad Alchemist throws back his head and cackles with insane glee!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Mad Alchemist babbles something incomprehensible and attacks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle alchemist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master summoner is here holding gateways open to other planes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master summoner

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The master charmer sizes you up, always looking for a new pet.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master charmer utters the words, 'uuuzzldctz'.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master charmer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks flammable.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wooden golem stands a silent vigil here, guarding the stairs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem wooden

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The master spell binder snarls at you and attacks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master spell binder is here re-charging a blackened wand.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master binder

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The golem maker is here chiseling some stone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master maker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks like a statue, until you see it shamble towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A granite golem stands here waiting to do its master's bidding.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem granite

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks rather dim witted.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bronze golem stands here shining in the light.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem bronze

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It looks to be made of a potpourri of different body parts; some don't even
resemble anything human.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A flesh golem stands guard here
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem flesh

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks like a bunch of old rags, quite surprising it can actually walk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cloth golem wanders around here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem cloth

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It seems to be forged of dark metal.  It looks strong and durable,
but somewhat un-intelligent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An adamantite golem stands here looking very dangerous.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem adamantite

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A clay golem stands guard here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle golem clay

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The image of an ugly dragon flickers slightly, and where the dragon was
now stands a small harmless looking old man.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An enormous multi-colored three-headed dragon growls at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master illusionist mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Attired all in black, the Necromancer is tall and gangly, but still quite
an imposing figure.  A dark cowl shrouds most of his face, but two blazing
embers which serve as eyes can be seen through the shadow.
The Necromancer shrieks some obscenities and orders his minions to attack.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Necromancer is here raising undead servants
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle necromancer master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It feels no pain, and hacks at you ruthlessly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An animated skeleton screams silently and attacks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle skeleton undead

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An undead giant lumbers towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle undead giant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She has no face at all, just blank skin, rather disturbing.  From about where
her mouth should be, comes a disgusting giggling sound that makes your skin
crawl with revulsion.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An ugly witch is here scrying out secrets.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle witch hag

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks like a rather peaceful old man.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Librarian has fallen asleep at his desk here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle librarian mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A powerful wizard in his own right, the apprentice of the master of balance
has given up his station in the mage guild hierarchy in order to serve the
great master in hopes of gleaning secrets one could never hope to uncover
alone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master's apprentice leaps to halt your passage.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apprentice

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The grey cat cocks an ear towards you, sensing your scrutiny, then purrs
contentedly.  It looks rather harmless, until you notice its very large claws.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A grey cat is lounging lazily here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cat grey familiar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks quite peaceful.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master of Neutrality stands here contemplating the balance of the universe.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master guildmaster grey

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She bears a wicked looking scar down the side of her face, though once she
must have been beautiful, now the scar combined with what seems to be a
permanent scowl make her looks quite fearsome.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A black robed apprentice jumps from the shadows and attacks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apprentice black

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It looks both mean and dangerous.  Petting seems to be completely out of
the question.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A black cat with its fur up hisses at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cat black familiar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The master glares at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master of the black robes is here plotting vile deeds.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master guildmaster black
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.short_descr: the master of the black robes

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks like a fanatic.
The apprentice screams 'Thou art unworthy of this honor!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A white robed apprentice screams at your desecration of goodness.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apprentice white

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It seems to be nothing more than a large ball of fluff with claws.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A white cat is here preening its fur.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cat white familiar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks like a self-righteous bastard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master of goodness is here frowning at your intrusion.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master guildmaster white

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It looks incredibly large for a cat, no doubt a giant of its species.
A beautiful jewel encrusted collar about its neck is its only adornment.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large calico cat is here
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cat calico familiar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She looks quite comfortable on her emerald throne. Amazingly young and
pretty for one of such stature in the guild, no doubt she has kept her
youthful appearance through the use of strong magics.
The Grand Master pets her familiar and smiles at you in confidence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Grand Mistress of Magic is sitting here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guildmaster grand mistress

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wandering wizard is here mumbling to himself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wizard
